title: Federated Class-Incremental Learning with Hierarchical Generative Prototypes
abstract: arXiv:2406.02447v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) aims at unburdening the training of deep models by distributing computation across multiple devices (clients) while safeguarding data privacy. On top of that, Federated Continual Learning (FCL) also accounts for data distribution evolving over time, mirroring the dynamic nature of real-world environments. While previous studies have identified Catastrophic Forgetting and Client Drift as major factors of performance degradation in FCL, we shed light on the importance of Incremental Bias and Federated Bias, which cause models to prioritize classes that are recently introduced or locally predominant, respectively. translated_title: 基于分层生成原型的联邦类增量学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）旨在通过将计算分散到多个设备（客户端）上来减轻深度模型训练的负担，同时保护数据隐私。在此基础上，联邦持续学习（FCL）还考虑了随时间演变的数据分布，反映了真实世界环境的动态特性。虽然以往的研究已经将灾难性遗忘和客户端漂移视为FCL中性能下降的主要因素，但我们揭示了增量偏差和联邦偏差的重要性，前者导致模型优先考虑最近引入的类别，后者导致模型优先考虑本地占主导地位的类别。我们的方法通过使用可学习的提示词高效微调预训练的骨干网络，将这两种偏差都限制在最后一层，从而使客户端产生偏差较小的表示和偏差较大的分类器。因此，我们不再仅仅依赖参数聚合，而是利用生成式（原型）……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了联邦类增量学习中的增量偏差与联邦偏差问题，通过可学习提示词微调预训练骨干网络将偏差限制在分类器最后一层，并结合分层生成原型机制来缓解灾难性遗忘和客户端漂移。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals incremental and federated biases in federated class-incremental learning, constrains both biases to the last layer via prompt-based fine-tuning of a pre-trained backbone, and leverages hierarchical generative prototypes to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and client drift.
